say_intro: 목성 구름 위에 떨어지면, 몇 분이나 버틸 수 있을까요?

beats.img: the top of giant banded orange and cream gas planet clouds seen from just above, vast swirling storm layers stretching to the horizon, cold pale light

beats.say: 몸무게가 2.36배로 느껴져요. 발 디딜 땅은 없고요.
beats.img: an endless ocean of thick swirling gas clouds with no solid ground anywhere, dim amber glow from below, heavy dark atmosphere
violent streaks of cream and rust coloured cloud bands torn sideways by extreme wind, fast motion blur, dramatic dark sky

beats.say: 공기의 89.8%는 수소예요. 숨 쉴 산소는 없어요.
beats.img: a thin hazy layer of pale gas glowing faintly in dark space, a single empty glass flask floating in front of swirling clouds
a small white parachute carrying a round metal science probe drifting down through dense orange gas clouds, dim light
a dented metal probe sinking into dark glowing red-orange dense gas, heat haze, deep murky atmosphere

caption: 목성에 떨어지면 몇 분 버틸까? 🪐
